amount.description: The total amount intended to be collected.

amountPaid.description: The amount of money paid toward the total.

amountDue.description: The outstanding amount of money to be paid.

canceledBy.description: The userId that canceled this. If this is a booking, tickets were canceled in addition.

recoveredAt.description: The date at which the customer recovered their checkout through cart abandonment.

code.description: The coupon code a customer enters.

amountOff.description: Flat discount amount in the specified `currency`. Only set if `percentOff` is not used.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO code for the `currency` (required when `amountOff` is set). Examples: usd, eur, gbp.

percentOff.description: Percentage discount (0-100) applied to payments using this coupon. Example: 50 applies 50% off ($100 payment becomes $50). Only set if `amountOff` is not used.

appliesToSetupFee.description: When enabled, applies this coupon discount to the setup fee.

duration.description: How long the discount applies: once (single payment), repeating (specified months), or forever (all future payments).

durationInMonths.description: If `duration` is `repeating`, the number of months the coupon applies. Null if coupon `duration` is forever or once.

redeemBy.description: The ISO datetime that this coupon must be used before.

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed globally. A single customer may redeem it multiple times.

timesRedeemed.description: The number of times this coupon has been redeemed.

deleted.description: If true, this coupon will be soft deleted. It is no longer usable but data is retained.

stripeCouponId.description: The unique identifier of the stripe coupon that was created with this coupon.

amount.description: The total amount intended to be collected.

amountPaid.description: The amount of money paid toward the total.

amountDue.description: The outstanding amount of money to be paid.

canceledBy.description: The userId that canceled this. If this is a booking, tickets were canceled in addition.

recoveredAt.description: The date at which the customer recovered their checkout through cart abandonment.

description.description: Product description in Lexical JSON format.

interval.description: Billing interval for subscriptions (day, week, month, year).

planIterations.description: Number of billing cycles (for installment plans).

status.description: Status of the variant. Defaults to `enabled`

fields.description: Custom form fields on the page.

Page.description: A checkout, event, or form page.

title.description: Product title. Defaults to page name if not provided.

description.description: Description of the product. Accepts HTML or plain text.
description.example: Join our premium course today learn more at Checkout Page.

price.description: Price in smallest currency unit (cents). Defaults to `0`.

payWhatYouWant.description: If enabled `price` field becomes the minimum price and customers can choose to pay what they want. If `price` is empty or `0` customer can purchase the product for free. Pay What You Want does not apply to subscriptions or payment plans.

pricingType.description: Pricing type for this product - single price or multiple prices using variants. Defaults to `single`. If set to `multiple` product `price` becomes 0.

discountedFromPrice.description: The original price of the product in the smallest currency unit (cents).

setupFeeMultipliesWithQuantity.description: Whether or not the setup fee is multipled by the selected quantity. Applies to `one-time` and `pwyw` only. Defaults to `false`.

trialPeriodDays.description: Trial period in days for subscriptions.

dayOfMonth.description: The first billing period will be prorated based on the remaining days in the month. Defaults to `1`.

startDate.description: The date on which the subscription begins.

recurring.description: The recurring components of a price such as `interval` and `intervalCount`

trialPeriodDays.description: Trial period in days for subscriptions.

dayOfMonth.description: The first billing period will be prorated based on the remaining days in the month. Defaults to `1`.

planIterations.description: The number of times a subscription renews. After set number of renewals the payment plan is complete.

startDate.description: The date on which the subscription begins.

paymentPlan.description: The payment plan components of a price such as `interval` and `intervalCount`

hasUnlimitedStock.description: Whether or not the stock of the product is unlimited. If set to `true`, the `stock` field is ignored.

taxBehavior.description: If Stripe Tax is enabled, determines the behaviour of Stripe Tax. Defaults to your Stripe Tax settings.

taxCode.description: If Stripe Tax is enabled, determines the tax code used when calculating tax. Defaults to your Stripe Tax settings.

media.description: Media for the product. Provide a list of fileIds. Use the `/files/upload` API to add images.

files.description: Files for the product. Available to the customer after purchase.

variantsRequired.description: Whether or not one or more variants are required at checkout. Defaults to `false`.

id.description: Unique identifier for this variant. Must be in BSON ObjectId format. It is recommended to only set the id if you need to reference this variant in preselect or conditional show/hide logic.

required.description: Whether the customer must select at least one option in the variant.

status.description: Status of the variant. Defaults to `enabled`

id.description: Unique identifier for this variant option. Must be in BSON ObjectId format. It is recommended to only set the id if you need to reference this variant in conditional show/hide logic.

status.description: Status of the option. Defaults to `enabled`.

description.description: Description of the option. Supports HTML or plain text.

additionalChargeAmount.description: The additional charge for selecting this variant option in cents.

discountedFromPrice.description: The original price of this variant option in cents.

type.description: Type of variant option - one-time purchase, recurring subscription or pay what you want.

payWhatYouWant.description: If enabled, customers can choose their own price for this variant option. The minimum price is based on the additionalChargeAmount. Defaults to `false`.

pwywSuggestedPrice.description: Suggested price for Pay What You Want options in cents. This is a cosmetic field used to display a suggested amount to the customer. Defaults to `0`.

files.description: Files specific to this variant option. Available to the customer after purchase.

reference.description: External reference ID. Defaults to a UUID v4.

selectionType.description: Type of selection. If `single` the customer can choose one option in the variant group. If `multiple` the customer can choose multiple options in the variant group. If `quantity` the customer can select multiple options and set a quantity of each variant in the variant group. Defaults to `single`

increasesWithQuantity.description: Whether or not the variant quantity matches the checkout quantity. Defaults to `false`.

useVariantOptionSkus.description: If enabled, use SKUs from variant options instead of the product SKU. Defaults to `false`.

manageVariantOptionStock.description: If enabled stock is managed by the variant options. Defaults to `false`.

hidden.description: Whether this variant is hidden. Hidden variants can be shown or filled with data by query paramers. [Learn more](https://checkoutpage.com/docs/articles/preselect-checkout-variants). Defaults to `false`.

enabled.description: Enable preselecting a variant option. Defaults to `false`.

optionId.description: ID of the variant option to preselect.

quantity.description: Quantity to preselect for quantity selection type variants. Defaults to `1` for `single` and `multiple` selection types.

enabled.description: Enable conditional show/hide logic. Defaults to `false`.

comparison.description: Comparison operator for the condition. Defaults to `IS`.

value.description: Unique identifier of the variant option being referenced. Must be a variant option within the same variant group

elementId.description: Unique identifier of the element (variant) being referenced.

showHideLogic.description: Conditional logic to show or hide this variant based on other form elements.

variantOptionLayout.description: Layout style for variant options. Defaults to `list`.

collapseVariantOptions.description: If enabled, variant options are collapsed by default. Defaults to `false`.

variantOptionColumns.description: Number of columns for grid layout. Defaults to `2`.

showVariantName.description: Show the variant name. Defaults to `true`.

showVariantOptionNames.description: Show variant option names. Defaults to `true`.

showVariantOptionPrices.description: Show variant option prices. Defaults to `true`.

showVariantOptionPriceSign.description: Show price sign (+ or -) for variant option prices. Defaults to `false`.

showPwywPlaceholder.description: Show placeholder text for Pay What You Want inputs. Defaults to `true`.

textAlign.description: Text alignment for variant options. Defaults to `left`.

spacing.description: Spacing between variant options. Defaults to `comfortable`.

imageSize.description: Size of variant option images. Defaults to `small`.

quantityCondition.description: Whether the discount applies based on the checkout quantity or specific variant option quantities. Defaults to `checkoutQuantity`.

variantOptions.description: Array of variant indexes. The index number will be mapped to a variant. This discount only applies to variants it is mapped to. Only used when quantityCondition is `variantOptionQuantity`.

minQuantity.description: Minimum quantity required for this discount to apply.

maxQuantity.description: Maximum quantity for this discount tier. Leave empty for no upper limit.

percentOff.description: Percentage discount to apply. Cannot be used with `amountOff`.

amountOff.description: Fixed amount discount in cents. Cannot be used with `percentOff`.

discounts.description: Offer discounts based on the number of items purchased. [Learn more](https://checkoutpage.com/docs/articles/bulk-discounts)

enabled.description: Enable Stripe-level subscription limits (checks active subscriptions in Stripe). Defaults to `false`.

limitSubscriptions.description: Configuration to limit the number of active subscriptions for this product. Used to cap subscriptions to a specific number.

generateLicenseKeys.description: If true, on purchase a license key for the product is generated

post.description: Creates a coupon. A coupon has either an amountOff and currency or percentOff. The coupon created will be automatically synchronized with Stripe if you have a connected stripe account. If you are not connected the endpoint will throw an error. In addition to Checkout Page rate limits, Stripe [rate limits](https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits) apply when creating coupons.

code.description: The coupon code a customer enters.

amountOff.description: A positive integer representing the amount to subtract from an invoice total (required if `percentOff` is not passed).

currency.description: Three-letter ISO code for the currency of the amountOff parameter (required if `amountOff` is passed).

durationInMonths.description: A positive integer representing the number of months the coupon applies for (required if `duration === repeating`)

percentOff.description: A positive float larger than 0, and smaller or equal to 100, that represents the discount the coupon will apply (required if `amountOff` is not passed).

appliesToSetupFee.description: When enabled, applies this coupon discount to the setup fee.

pageIds.description: A list of pageIds that this coupon can be used within.

maxRedemptions.description: The total amount of times this coupon can be used. Doesn't limit a single customer from redeeming multiple times.

redeemBy.description: The ISO datetime that this coupon must be used before.
